target: Implement resource-map builder and drift CI: dcp resource-map sync [--check], generation from canonical sources (taxonomy path detectors, approval_policy canonical_writers, root_hygiene_policy), CI drift gate, and fold-and-retire scripts/verify_runtime_authority.py.
invariants: Never wire or import the merge seam (the queue drain or any live lane-merge path).
Never compute live SHAs for static fixtures — only allowed for runtime git reads explicitly carved out in design D-E.
Never self-certify — the auditor identity in the proof bundle must differ from the implementer; operator verifies before orchestrator advance.
Never bind ConPort, dope-memory, or task-orchestrator endpoints — no live service calls.
Never promote external corroboration (DR-015, DR-016) to repo authority — cite provenance tags as EXTERNAL_PROPOSED or REPO_VALIDATED.
LIVE_WRITE_READY remains undefined and blocking — classifier blocked-posture on any PROVISIONAL class that lacks an approval_policy.yaml entry.
The resource map must be generated from canonical sources — no hand-maintained sections for paths or canonical_writers; endpoint_bindings remain PROVISIONAL and are not generated.
scripts/verify_runtime_authority.py must be retired (deleted or explicitly replaced) — two validator sources for the same data is a violation of the single-source rule.
The CI drift gate must fail (non-zero) when resource map content diverges from canonical sources — no silent pass on drift.

pr.title: feat(dcp): resource-map builder + drift CI + retire verify_runtime_authority.py (DMX-DCP-TOOLING-111)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Implements `dopemux dcp resource-map sync [--check]` subcommand per design D-F.
- Builder derives config/dcp/project_resource_map.json sections from canonical sources: forbidden_paths/red_line_paths from C1 taxonomy path detectors; canonical_writers_map from approval_policy.yaml canonical_writer fields; root hygiene / placement from config/repo_hygiene/root_hygiene_policy.json. endpoint_bindings section left unchanged as PROVISIONAL.
- `--check` mode: regenerate in memory, diff against committed instance, exit non-zero if drift detected (CI mode).
- Adds drift gate CI step in .github/workflows/ci-complete.yml using --check mode.
- Folds useful checks from scripts/verify_runtime_authority.py into the CI consistency test and retires (deletes) the dead script — one validator, not two.

## Validation
- Regenerate → diff → clean passes.
- Source-mutation fixture → drift detected (CI gate fails).
- scripts/verify_runtime_authority.py absent from repo after TP.

## NOT_RUN
- Endpoint bindings section automation (PROVISIONAL, out of scope).

steps.task: Preflight: inspect current project_resource_map.json (if it exists), scripts/verify_runtime_authority.py to identify its useful checks, red_lane_taxonomy.json path detector structure (from TP-102), approval_policy.yaml canonical_writer fields, and root_hygiene_policy.json structure.
commands: python -m json.tool config/dcp/project_resource_map.json 2>/dev/null | head -60 || echo 'NOT YET CREATED'
python -m json.tool config/dcp/red_lane_taxonomy.json | grep -A3 'path_pattern' | head -40 || true
validation: Current resource_map.json state documented (existing or absent).
Canonical source structures for all generated sections confirmed readable.

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/dcp/resource_map.py with build_resource_map() function. Sections derived from canonical sources: (1) forbidden_paths/red_line_paths: extract path_pattern detectors from each hard_block lane in the taxonomy instance; (2) canonical_writers_map: extract capability entries with canonical_writer fields from approval_policy.yaml; (3) root_hygiene sections: from root_hygiene_policy.json; (4) roots section: from repo layout existence checks. endpoint_bindings: copy as-is from existing instance (PROVISIONAL, not generated). The function is pure — reads source files, returns derived map, no writes.

Generate config/dcp/project_resource_map.json by running build_resource_map() against the current canonical sources. Add dcp resource-map sync [--check] to cli_dcp.py: sync writes the generated map to config/dcp/project_resource_map.json; --check regenerates in memory and diffs — exits non-zero if any drift is detected.
validation: dopemux dcp resource-map sync --check exits 0 (no drift immediately after generation).

steps.task: Fold the useful validation checks from scripts/verify_runtime_authority.py into tests/dcp/test_resource_map.py and the CI consistency test. Then delete scripts/verify_runtime_authority.py. Record the retirement decision in the commit message. Confirm no other file imports or calls verify_runtime_authority.py.
validation: scripts/verify_runtime_authority.py absent from repo after this step.
No remaining imports or references to verify_runtime_authority in the codebase.
Useful checks from the retired script are covered by test_resource_map.py or the CI gate.

steps.task: Add CI drift gate step to .github/workflows/ci-complete.yml: run `PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen dopemux dcp resource-map sync --check` as a job step. The step fails the job on drift. Note: this TP touches .github/workflows/ which is a hard_block path — hand-authored APPROVAL.json is required if this is a sanctioned change per design B.6. Confirm an APPROVAL.json is included or document why this TP does not yet require it (gate not yet enforcing in warn-only phase).
validation: CI drift gate step present in ci-complete.yml.
B.6 APPROVAL.json present if required, or warn-only phase documented in proof.
